INSPIRE.TEXT: TRAVL PLANR is your smart travel companion — simplifying itineraries, tailoring experiences, and giving you full control over transport, stays, and activities, all with clear inclusions and no hidden costs.

INTRO.ASKED_TEXT:
"What if we could simplify everything into one smart, intuitive platform?"
So we did.
INTRO.PARAGRAPH: TRAVL PLANR is the modern traveler's solution for personalized itineraries. Our AI assistant analyzes your unique preferences, budget, and schedule to build real-time travel plans. The editable itineraries put you in full control, so you can adapt and refine your journey with ease. Stop wasting time planning and start exploring—TRAVL PLANR handles the details.
INTRO.TITLE: About TRAVL PLANR
INTRO.WHY_TEXT: Planning a trip often takes longer than the trip itself. From comparing cities and hotels to figuring out transport and local experiences — it's overwhelming.

JOIN.TEXT:
Every unforgettable journey begins with a story worth sharing — "Remember that trip when we…". At TRAVL PLANR, we take care of the details, so you can focus on the moments that truly matter.

From your first click to your final day, we're here to make travel effortless, personal, and memorable. Whether it's a family getaway, a solo adventure, or a once-in-a-lifetime escape, we help you turn plans into experiences — and experiences into stories you'll carry forever.

Ready to see the world differently? Your next adventure starts here.

STEPS.HEADING: 3 Steps to Your Perfect Trip

STEP1.DESCRIPTION: Start by entering your destination and travel dates. Then answer a few quick questions about your preferences — and that's it. TRAVL PLANR does the rest.

HIGHLIGHTS.ITEM1: Choose a destination, city, or region for your trip
HIGHLIGHTS.ITEM2: Set travel dates, group size, and trip type
HIGHLIGHTS.ITEM3: Share your budget range and preferred travel style
HIGHLIGHTS.ITEM4: Choose interests like beaches, culture, adventure, food, nature, or nightlife

STEP1.LABEL: Step 1
STEP1.TITLE: Tell Us About Your Trip

STEP2.DESCRIPTION: The AI assembles a day-by-day travel plan tailored to your inputs. Hotels, activities, restaurants, and transfers are presented as editable suggestions that you can verify and refine.

HIGHLIGHTS.ITEM1: Review a day-by-day schedule with morning, afternoon, and evening ideas
HIGHLIGHTS.ITEM2: Compare stay suggestions across budget ranges
HIGHLIGHTS.ITEM3: Explore local attractions, restaurants, and flexible activity ideas
HIGHLIGHTS.ITEM4: Plan inter-city transfers with flights, trains, cars, or other options

STEP2.LABEL: Step 2

MOCK.DAY1_DETAIL: Tanah Lot Temple → Beach Sunset → Dinner at Merah Putih
MOCK.DAY3_DETAIL: Kelingking Beach → Angel's Billabong → Broken Beach

STEP2.TITLE: Get Your AI-Generated Itinerary

STEP3.DESCRIPTION: Your itinerary is just the starting point. Tweak any activity, swap out a hotel, add a restaurant, or remove a stop — the AI instantly re-optimizes the plan. Then book everything on trusted platforms.

HIGHLIGHTS.ITEM1: Reorder days, activities, and stays as your plans change
HIGHLIGHTS.ITEM2: Use partner handoffs for hotels, flights, tours, and cars
HIGHLIGHTS.ITEM3: Book directly with providers rather than through a hidden middle layer
HIGHLIGHTS.ITEM4: Share your plan with travel companions for collaborative review

STEP3.LABEL: Step 3
STEP3.TITLE: Personalize, Then Book

STEPS.SUBHEADING: No spreadsheets. No endless browser tabs. Just smart, guided planning powered by AI.

PDF.WHAT_WE_DO_ITEM_1: We provide an AI-powered tool to help you plan trips based on your destination, dates, and preferences.

PDF.FAQ_Q1_QUESTION: 1. What is Travl Planr, and how does it stand out from other travel websites?
PDF.FAQ_Q1_ANSWER: Travl Planr is a free, AI-powered platform that creates personalized travel itineraries in moments. Unlike traditional sites, we focus on planning and customization, letting you tweak hotels, transport, and activities before continuing to trusted partners like TravelNext and Tripadvisor when you are ready.
PDF.FAQ_Q2_QUESTION: 2. Can I plan trips across multiple cities or countries?
PDF.FAQ_Q2_ANSWER: Yes, Travl Planr supports multi-city and cross-border trips. Our AI suggests optimal transport between locations, which you can adjust to fit your preferences.
PDF.FAQ_Q3_QUESTION: 3. How does the AI plan my trip?
PDF.FAQ_Q3_ANSWER: After you enter details like destination, travel dates, group size, and interests, the AI generates a personalized day-by-day itinerary with suggested hotels, experiences, and travel options.
PDF.FAQ_Q4_QUESTION: 4. What transport options does the AI include?
PDF.FAQ_Q4_ANSWER: The AI selects the best mode based on distance—including rental cars, trains, buses, or flights—which you can change as needed.
PDF.FAQ_Q5_QUESTION: 5. Is it safe to pay on the linked websites?
PDF.FAQ_Q5_ANSWER: Yes. We only link to trusted providers and destination tools such as TravelNext, Tripadvisor, and Google Maps, with no hidden agents or extra intermediaries involved.
